description: topology_interface_poll command payload v1 (M3 Task 3). Server-built by the telemetry-arm dispatcher; the agent collects IF-MIB state/counters for exactly `interfaces` from `target` and answers with an if_metrics envelope echoing producerEpoch/configurationRevision/sequence/expectedIntervalSeconds and the command id. `binding` is server-only (scope + authority the result adapter re-derives from the STORED command); the agent ignores it. The three snmp* secret fields are top-level strings so sensitiveCommandPayload field encryption and terminal erasure apply; `erased` shows a terminal row (secrets stripped) that the result adapter must still parse. `valid`, `validV2c` and `erased` parse in TS and Go; every `invalid` command is rejected by both.
